nodes.label: BS2-001: sp500 pct_change was 12 trading days, not YoY
nodes.rationale: pct_change(periods=N) is row-based; on daily series N must be 252 per year. At 12 the value was ~1/20th of true YoY so the DANGER band never fired, silently removing sp500 from the composite. Lehman now correctly reads -19.6% YoY.
nodes.norm_label: bs2-001: sp500 pct_change was 12 trading days, not yoy

nodes.label: BS2-002: incremental-fetch lookback map missing 'daily' key
nodes.rationale: Without a daily entry the 252-period daily KPIs fell through to 32 days/period and re-downloaded ~22 years of history on every refresh.
nodes.norm_label: bs2-002: incremental-fetch lookback map missing 'daily' key

nodes.label: BS2-003: /api/refresh check-then-set race
nodes.rationale: A boolean _refresh_running flag is read-then-written non-atomically; replaced with a non-blocking threading.Lock so concurrent POSTs cannot both start a refresh.

nodes.label: BS2-004: live AI commentary cache never invalidated after refresh
nodes.rationale: Refresh worker now deletes today's AiCommentary rows only; historical Time-Machine commentary is kept because its inputs are immutable.
nodes.norm_label: bs2-004: live ai commentary cache never invalidated after refresh

nodes.label: BS2-005: N+1 queries in /api/kpis (~156 per request)
nodes.rationale: Per-KPI queries replaced by a row_number() window query; 78 KPIs now resolve in 0.17s.
nodes.norm_label: bs2-005: n+1 queries in /api/kpis (~156 per request)

nodes.label: BS2-006: missing stale-token guards in CategoryPage / KpiDetailPage / KpiDetailChart
nodes.norm_label: bs2-006: missing stale-token guards in categorypage / kpidetailpage / kpidetailchart

nodes.label: BS2-007: SettingsPage swallowed save and load errors
nodes.rationale: try/finally with no catch meant a 400 from POST /api/config vanished silently.
nodes.norm_label: bs2-007: settingspage swallowed save and load errors

nodes.label: BS2-008: HomePage had no error state on core fetch failure
nodes.norm_label: bs2-008: homepage had no error state on core fetch failure

nodes.label: BS2-009: tautological e2e assertion masked top-nav as_of regression
nodes.rationale: The regex /\/(\?|$)/ in category.spec.ts passed whether or not the query string survived, hiding that nav links dropped ?as_of=. Assertions must pin the literal value, not a pattern satisfied by both states.
nodes.norm_label: bs2-009: tautological e2e assertion masked top-nav as_of regression

nodes.label: BS2-011: uploadCsv did not check res.ok
nodes.norm_label: bs2-011: uploadcsv did not check res.ok

nodes.label: BS2-012: derived_ratio stale-denominator warning
nodes.rationale: Warns when the numerator is >45 days newer than the denominator, which produced stale-GDP Buffett Indicator values with no signal.

nodes.label: PYT-001: threshold NEVER_TRIGGERS for 7 KPIs
nodes.rationale: housing_starts, building_permits, housing_affordability, mortgage_delinquency, nfci, biz_loan_delinquency and anfci have 5-year ranges that never cross even WARNING, so they contribute a constant 0.0 and are dead weight in the weighted composite. Thresholds must be calibrated against observed value range, not textbook levels.

nodes.label: PYT-002: gold_price permanently at DANGER
nodes.rationale: Gold YoY exceeded the 30% danger threshold for 251 consecutive trading days (min 32.4%), pinning sub_score at 1.0 and biasing financial_stress upward forever. A permanently-saturated KPI carries no information.

nodes.label: PYT-003: shiller_cape always at DANGER (likely accurate)
nodes.rationale: Deferred rather than fixed: last 19 monthly readings min 35.08 vs danger 35.0, which may genuinely reflect extreme valuations. Recommended discriminator is the long-run 90th/95th percentile rather than an absolute level.
nodes.norm_label: pyt-003: shiller_cape always at danger (likely accurate)

nodes.label: PYT-004: 7 stale KPIs in live DB, verified upstream
nodes.rationale: Direct FRED queries confirmed the upstream series themselves are stuck at the same dates, so the watchdog is correctly reporting real publication lag rather than a fetcher failure. Classified LOW and deferred.
nodes.norm_label: pyt-004: 7 stale kpis in live db, verified upstream

nodes.label: PYT-005: housing_starts and housing_affordability share FRED HOUST
nodes.rationale: Two KPIs backed by one series move identically and double-count into the housing category. Documented as intentional after FIXHAI was discontinued, but flagged as suspect.
nodes.norm_label: pyt-005: housing_starts and housing_affordability share fred houst

nodes.label: PW-001: Flask returned 404 for SPA deep links
nodes.rationale: Flask(static_url_path="") registers a /<path:filename> static rule that matches before the catch-all, so /category/* and /kpi/* returned Flask's Not Found page. Fixed with static_folder=None so serve_spa owns all unknown paths.
nodes.norm_label: pw-001: flask returned 404 for spa deep links

nodes.label: AR1-001: orphan fedfunds rows persist after retirement
nodes.rationale: 243 rows survive because purge_retired_kpis only deletes ids hard-coded in _RETIRED_KPI_IDS. Dead weight now, and a foot-gun if fedfunds is re-added with a different transform since stale rows would silently merge.
nodes.norm_label: ar1-001: orphan fedfunds rows persist after retirement

nodes.label: AR1-002: /api/kpis exposes no per-KPI stale flag
nodes.rationale: The watchdog logs staleness to app.log but the API only returns OK/WARNING/DANGER, so users see OK cards for data months out of date. Fixed by surfacing a boolean stale field using the same per-frequency windows.
nodes.norm_label: ar1-002: /api/kpis exposes no per-kpi stale flag

nodes.label: AR2-001: future as_of generated and persisted 873 fake cache rows
nodes.rationale: The month loop ran Jan 2007 to Jan 2099 and unconditionally persisted every computed month as cache. Fix caps end_date to min(as_of, today) so future dates never enter the loop.
nodes.norm_label: ar2-001: future as_of generated and persisted 873 fake cache rows

nodes.label: AR2-002: Time Machine score never clamped for future as_of
nodes.rationale: _value_as_of returns the most recent value <= as_of, which for any future date is just today's value. The response is byte-identical to live but carries simulated:true and the user's future date, so the UI lies about being a projection.
nodes.norm_label: ar2-002: time machine score never clamped for future as_of

nodes.label: AR2-003: actual_value_at_forecast_date leaked today's data
nodes.rationale: Query KpiData.date <= forecast_target always finds today's row when the target is in the future, so the forecast-validation UI treated present data as ground truth for an unreached horizon. Fixed by mirroring the forecast_target <= today guard.

nodes.label: AR2-004: forecast never returns actual_score in live mode
nodes.rationale: A hard 'as_of is not None' gate forces users into Time Machine to see any accuracy comparison, even though as_of=today-90d is a computable backtest.
nodes.norm_label: ar2-004: forecast never returns actual_score in live mode

nodes.label: AR3-001: KpiDetailChart renders blank for single-data-point KPIs
nodes.rationale: An SVG path needs >=2 points, so with dot={false} a one-row history renders axes and threshold lines but no visible mark. Hits any newly onboarded KPI for a release cycle until it accumulates 2 post-transform values.
nodes.norm_label: ar3-001: kpidetailchart renders blank for single-data-point kpis

nodes.label: AR3-002: history endpoint 500 misreported as 'no data, run a refresh'
nodes.rationale: Promise.all wired only .finally, never .catch, so a 500 leaves history=[] and shows the empty-state copy. Telling the user to run a refresh when the server is broken is misleading because refresh hits the same backend.
nodes.norm_label: ar3-002: history endpoint 500 misreported as 'no data, run a refresh'

nodes.label: AR3-003: tooltip dead zone at far-left and far-right chart edges
nodes.rationale: Recharts computes x = mouseX - tipWidth/2, pushing the tip to negative CSS left at the edges. The dead zone covers the most useful dates: the current value and the oldest baseline.
nodes.norm_label: ar3-003: tooltip dead zone at far-left and far-right chart edges

nodes.label: AR3-004: Promise.all coupling suppresses chart when only NBER shading fails
nodes.rationale: Promise.all has no partial-success path, so a failure in the purely decorative NBER shading call suppresses the entire line chart. Promise.allSettled or independent fetches would degrade gracefully.
nodes.norm_label: ar3-004: promise.all coupling suppresses chart when only nber shading fails

nodes.label: AR4-001: POST /api/config type-validation DoS
nodes.rationale: Keys are whitelisted but values are not type-checked, so posting a string into a numeric threshold persists it and the next GET calls float("high") and 500s. Single unauthenticated POST locks the settings page until the DB is hand-edited.

nodes.label: AR4-002: CSV upload accepts future-dated rows
nodes.rationale: One row dated 2099 becomes the de-facto current reading until 2099 because status is computed from the latest value <= as_of, poisoning charts, score history and backtests.
nodes.norm_label: ar4-002: csv upload accepts future-dated rows

nodes.label: AR4-003: CSV upload silently accepts files missing required columns
nodes.rationale: Returns 200 with rows_saved:0 instead of an error, so the user believes the import succeeded. fieldnames must be validated before iterating and rows_saved==0 must be a 400.
nodes.norm_label: ar4-003: csv upload silently accepts files missing required columns

nodes.label: AR4-004: unknown KPI id on history endpoint returns 200 []
nodes.rationale: No security risk since SQL is parameterised, but clients cannot distinguish 'valid KPI with no data' from 'garbage id'. Path-traversal ids reroute to the SPA fallback and return HTML from a JSON endpoint.
nodes.norm_label: ar4-004: unknown kpi id on history endpoint returns 200 []

nodes.label: AR4-005: AI commentary generated for non-existent categories
nodes.rationale: category_id is never validated, so the model hallucinates 200 words of analysis for a bogus id, burns Anthropic tokens, and the result is cached to DB so every later call returns the nonsense row.
nodes.norm_label: ar4-005: ai commentary generated for non-existent categories

nodes.label: AR4-006: CSV upload leaks UnicodeDecodeError internals
nodes.rationale: Status code 400 is correct but a bare 'except Exception as exc' returns raw exception args to the client. No PII or path leak, so normalisation only.
nodes.norm_label: ar4-006: csv upload leaks unicodedecodeerror internals

nodes.label: AR5-001: /api/score returned date 2099-01-01 from corrupt cache
nodes.rationale: api_score picks MAX(date) from recession_scores, so 873 future-dated cache rows written by the history endpoint made the headline homepage score dated 73 years ahead even after a fresh refresh. Root cause is the absence of any shared no-future-dated-writes guard.
nodes.norm_label: ar5-001: /api/score returned date 2099-01-01 from corrupt cache

nodes.label: AR5-002: /api/score and /api/score/history latest disagree by 1.0 point
nodes.rationale: Downstream of AR5-001. Residual difference is that the two endpoints read different reference dates: today's daily row versus the first-of-month snapshot.
nodes.norm_label: ar5-002: /api/score and /api/score/history latest disagree by 1.0 point

nodes.label: AR5-003: /api/* typos masked as 200 + index.html by SPA fallback
nodes.rationale: The SPA catch-all matches unknown /api/* paths, so a typo'd fetch receives an HTML page that JSON-parses into a cryptic "Unexpected token '<'". An explicit /api/<path:_> 404 handler registered before the catch-all would fix it.
nodes.norm_label: ar5-003: /api/* typos masked as 200 + index.html by spa fallback

nodes.label: AR5-004: prior-loop bugs re-confirmed still active
nodes.rationale: The threshold audit tests pass only because they emit advisory print() rather than assert, which is why six known-bad findings survived multiple loops unfixed. Advisory-only tests do not defend an invariant.
nodes.norm_label: ar5-004: prior-loop bugs re-confirmed still active

nodes.label: AR5-005: 41 ERROR log entries — watchdog noise plus buffett_indicator failure
nodes.rationale: 35 of 41 errors are known-laggy series logged at ERROR, causing alarm fatigue that hid the 5 genuine buffett_indicator fetch failures. Known publication lag should log at WARN.
nodes.norm_label: ar5-005: 41 error log entries — watchdog noise plus buffett_indicator failure

nodes.rationale: Probed 7 hypotheses, 2 bugs found. Cleared: NULL latest_value, sign-mismatch, NBER overlap, category counts, score-history cadence.

nodes.label: Autoresearch Loop 2 — Time Machine Correctness
nodes.rationale: 7 hypotheses, 4 confirmed bugs. Verified working: Lehman 2008-09-15 scores 74.7 HIGH, as_of history is a strict subset of live, no as_of leakage across 78 KPIs, and as_of=today reconstructs live exactly.

nodes.label: Autoresearch Loop 3 — Frontend Rendering
nodes.rationale: 8 hypotheses probed via curl plus a throwaway Playwright spec. Cleared: chart outlier clipping, sparkline empty-state, CSV upload inputs, missing ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, refresh poll on 500.

nodes.label: Autoresearch Loop 4 — API Error Paths
nodes.rationale: Run against a live Flask process; all bugs reproduced multiple times and DB pollution from tests cleaned up at session end.

nodes.label: Autoresearch Loop 5 — Cross-Cutting
nodes.rationale: Validates that subsystems agree with each other rather than testing them in isolation: score endpoints, category counts, refresh idempotency, log noise, prior-loop bug status.

nodes.label: 2026-06-12 bug-sweep session (146 tests passing)
nodes.rationale: 74 pytest plus 72 Playwright specs green; this session both introduced the BS2-xxx findings and closed most previously deferred items.

nodes.label: Severity triage scheme (BLOCK > HIGH > MED > LOW)
nodes.rationale: Ranks a silently-wrong result (HIGH) above a merely broken feature only when the feature still functions: BLOCK is a broken feature, HIGH is a silent wrong result, LOW is cosmetic. Silent wrongness outranks visible breakage because users cannot detect it.
nodes.norm_label: severity triage scheme (block > high > med > low)

nodes.label: Missing shared 'no future-dated writes' guard
nodes.rationale: BUGS.md names this absent invariant explicitly as the common root cause linking AR5-001 and AR4-002: no layer of the codebase rejects a write whose date is beyond today, so every ingestion path (score-history cache, CSV upload, forecast actuals) independently reinvented the same corruption.

nodes.label: Threshold NEVER_TRIGGERS audit
nodes.rationale: tests/test_thresholds_audit.py compares each KPI's observed 5-year range against its configured warning/danger levels, catching both never-fires and always-fires saturation. Its weakness is that it reports via print() rather than assert, so findings do not fail CI.

nodes.label: Staleness watchdog ERROR-vs-WARN log level
nodes.rationale: Known real-world publication lag logged at ERROR produced 35 of 41 daily error lines, creating alarm fatigue that concealed genuine failures. Expected lag belongs at WARN; ERROR should be reserved for conditions implying a code or source defect.

nodes.label: Frontend stale-response token guard pattern
nodes.rationale: A useRef counter incremented per load() call lets a component discard responses from superseded requests, preventing an older in-flight fetch from overwriting newer state when the user changes the Time Machine date rapidly. Originated in HomePage and replicated to the other pages in BS2-006.

nodes.label: Unknown-id 404 contract for API endpoints
nodes.rationale: Endpoints taking an id from the URL must validate it against kpi_config.yaml or the category map and return 404, otherwise clients cannot distinguish an empty-but-valid resource from a garbage id, and generative endpoints will fabricate content for ids that do not exist.

hyperedges.label: Future-dated write contamination across ingestion paths
